text:
SDP
Description
These commands allow you to get and set various different pieces of
information in a Session Description Protocol (SDP) session.
NOTE:
The features contained in this namespace are available with
a general license only in 9.4.2 and later. Earlier releases require an
EA (Early Access) license to use these features. These commands will
not function if your system does not have this license installed. For
more information, read about the LicenseDetails
Command List
SDP::field
- Returns the value in a given
SDP field
SDP::media
- Get or set SDP media
information
SDP::session_id
- Get the SDP session
id
Note: SDP commands behave correctly on MRF framework
